description: Put an existing PDF onto the PDF/UA "vessel". If it is already tagged, the structure tree is untouched and only missing document-level requirements are supplied (MarkInfo / Lang / DisplayDocTitle / XMP pdfuaid and dc:title). For untagged documents, a minimal structure tree (each page = one P element) is created so the content becomes reachable by assistive technology. **IMPORTANT**: machines cannot infer meaning — headings, tables, lists, reading order and figure alt text are NOT created. The new tree is a scaffold, not an accessible document; it needs human review. If you can build the structure right from the start, use the create tools' tagged: true. For signed PDFs, preserveSignatures: true (approval signatures only; certification signatures are refused). The result separates addedRequirements (absent from the input) from replacedRequirements (present with a different value, rewritten); a requirement already present with the same value is neither rewritten nor listed. requirementsChanged is false when nothing was added, replaced or created — the output file is still written (v0.24.0). The declared part follows the input version (header or catalog /Version), which is never changed: PDF/UA-1 (pdfuaid:part 1) for PDF 1.0 to 1.7 (ISO 14289-1 §6.1), PDF/UA-2 (pdfuaid:part 2, rev 2024) for PDF 2.0 (ISO 14289-2 §6.1). For PDF 2.0, a new tree puts Document and P in the PDF 2.0 namespace; an existing tree whose root is not a single Document in that namespace (ISO 14289-2 §8.2.5.2) is left as it is and named in warnings (v0.27.0).

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the target PDF.

lang.description: Natural language of the document (BCP 47, e.g. "ja"). Required by PDF/UA-1 7.2 / PDF/UA-2 8.4.4.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

preserveSignatures.description: Edit a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. Changes beyond the certification (DocMDP) permission level are refused.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

title.description: Document title (required by PDF/UA-1 7.1 / PDF/UA-2 8.11.1). Falls back to the existing Info Title, then the XMP dc:title.
